meta.title: NetEase Music Player
meta.description: A small floating player inside DSH, wired to your local NetEase Cloud Music client: prev / play-pause / next, drag the volume, scrolling lyrics.

player.noClientHint: Open the NetEase client and start a song; this panel picks it up automatically
player.helperDownHint: Hit retry, or wait for the automatic restart
player.noLyricsHint: No lyrics found for this track
player.lyricsOffHint: Turn on "fetch lyrics" in the settings
